Pick from a set of designed tables, player figurines and balls to match your mood.
Opt for 3 or 4-row grid layouts, tailoring the challenge to your skill level.
Solo play? No problem. Got a friend? Even better! Dive into head-to-head battles on a shared screen.

Track your progression, snag those coveted trophies, and lay down the gauntlet as the Pocket Foosball maestro everyone's talking about.

Joy-Con controllers ready? Let's bring that tabletop action to life!

70010000074179.name: Western Frontier
70010000074179.intro: An action shooter in which Billy, an assassin, fights in the frontier days of the West!
70010000074179.description:
Western Frontier is a 2D action shooting game.
Defeat rogues, earn bounties, and restore peace to the town.
At the tavern, you can strengthen your weapons and buy new ones.
Use a wide variety of weapons and instant evasion to take down all the wanted criminals.

70010000074184.name: Cats on Streets
70010000074184.intro: Cats on Streets invites players to spot and uncover hidden feline friends in cities like Tokyo, Paris, and London. Unleash your inner detective and embark on this charming cat-hunting adventure!
70010000074184.description:
"Hey there! Ever dreamt of a chill gaming session that feels like a gentle breeze on a sunny day? Well, let me introduce you to ""Cats on Streets,"" a game designed to make you unwind and smile.

Picture this: you're stepping into the shoes of a seasoned globetrotter returning home to her cozy nook. But there's a twist - you're also playing hide-and-seek with adorable feline friends amidst the charming cityscapes of Tokyo, Paris, and London.

Now, the magic unfolds as you explore these cities through beautifully hand-drawn scenes. Your goal? Find those elusive kitties hidden in plain sight, up to 50 of them in each scene. As you spot them, the scenes burst into vibrant colors, revealing the true beauty of each illustration.

With a bunch of pictures to uncover and a whopping 350 cats to find, this game is all about unwinding, enjoying the hunt, and celebrating the joy of art and cats coming together. So, grab a cup of your favorite brew, cozy up, and let's embark on this delightful cat-hunting journey!"

70010000074191.name: Draw and Color
70010000074191.intro: Draw, paint, choose your painting tools, and progress with Draw and Color!
70010000074191.description:
Draw and Color is an addictive game for all ages that provides players with the opportunity to color and draw on virtual canvases. There is a huge variety of images available in the game, from cute animals to abstract works of art.

Key Features:

Variety of Tools: You can use brushes, pencils, markers, and other tools to create your works of art.

Many colors: The color palette offers a huge number of different shades to give you complete freedom in choosing colors.

Meditative Mode: The game offers a meditative drawing experience that helps you relax and relieve stress.

Draw and Color is suitable for both children and adults and promotes creative thinking and relaxation, allowing everyone to become an artist.

70010000074198.name: Sketch Personality Test
70010000074198.intro:
Just follow the instructions and draw!
Your drawings will lay bare your true feelings!?
70010000074198.description:
Simple drawing reveals the hidden you…
An unique personality test!

By drawing a face on a heart, ... you maybe find out your attitude towards the person whom you love?

・From the eye make-up, your embarrassing *** will be ... :X
・You can tell *** from the size of the cucumber you draw... <3
・Even some sensual tests so sure to be a tons of 
　fun to play with your crushes or with your friends <3

Have fun with this game whenever, wherever!

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, so you can play in TV Mode, Handheld Mode, or Tabletop Mode.

70010000074199.name: Mystery Solving! BrainQuiz
70010000074199.intro:
Can you solve this problem?
Brain training quizzes that will test your observation skills!
70010000074199.description:
Includes many brain training quizzes that can be solved by flexing your brain!

Is the answer you got from your quick glance really the correct one?
The true answer is always hidden in the illustration!
Please observe carefully without any preconceived notions!

Don't worry if you struggle with difficult or tricky problems!
We will support you with our hint function

Compete with your family and friends to see who can solve the puzzles faster!
Use your inspiration and deductive powers to solve all the puzzles!

[Recommended for those who]
・Like escape games and werewolves
・Like suspense movies and dramas
・Want to exercise your brain while killing time
・Like solving puzzles 
・Want to test your abilities
・Want to improve your observation skills 
・Like mysteries

70010000074200.name: I SEEK! WHERE IS "PICTO"-SAN?
70010000074200.intro:
“Picto”-san is missing!?
Find the “Picto”-san, famous as a pictogram of emergency exit!
70010000074200.description:
Well-known “Emergency Exit character”, “Picto”-san had a story!?
　
Find the “Picto”-san that fits the theme, which fills the screen with human (picto) relationship!
A brand new type of picture quiz you have never seen before!
　
Stages are filled and configured with daily event scenes such as “Medical check up”,“sports festival” and fantasy event scenes like “zombie train”,“treasure island”
　
If you can find out where “Picto”-san is, you can read an funny fact related to “Picto”-san
　
Compete with your family or friends who will find first, and also recommended for video streaming by streamers!

70010000074201.name: The ZVENGERS -INFINITY DEFENSE-
70010000074201.intro: The Z virus, able to turn anyone into a monster, was stolen?! At this rate, the monsters will take over. Stop the villain who stole the Z virus and save the world!
70010000074201.description:
Dr. Zstein is an eccentric scientist hard at work studying the Z virus, a new strain that can turn anyone infected into a ferocious monster.

One day, an assistant Zzalgun who was accidentally exposed to the Z virus gained superpowers instead of turning into a monster!

"Under certain conditions, it seems one can be granted superpowers without the downsides of infection."
In response to this new discovery, Zstein begins his research into how to suppress the monsterfication and extract only the super power strains.

Yet, Researcher X, wanting to conquer the world with the Z virus, steals all the research data and antidotes before running away. In the process, the Z virus leaks out into the world, causing absolute mayhem in the lab...

Can Dr. Zstein and the Zzalgun, mankind's last hope, stop Researcher X and save the world from these mutations?

[ Gameplay ]

- Defend your tower against the evil forces!
The monsters created by the head of the lab Researcher X are coming! Players must use their limited resources to create and strategically deploy new units. Construct solid lines of defense and fire your cannons to drive away the invaders one at a time and destroy the enemy's towers.

- Power up your super-simple manufacturing systems
Gain coins by defeating your enemies. Use this gold to strengthen your main force or reinforce your turrets, all to overwhelm your enemies and claim victory.

- Featuring characters from Today's Meme!
Characters from the popular emoji pack Today's Meme appear in the game! In addition to the familiar Zzalgun and Zzalyang, players can use dozens of other Today's Meme characters, each with their extraordinary skills, to defeat their enemies!

70010000074210.name: Forbidden Ghost Photo
70010000074210.intro: Find the hiding invisible spirit in the photo by using your spiritual-vision-smartphone!
70010000074210.description:
The smartphone you got...
It had a special ability to see the spirits......

A picture of a mundane, ordinary day...
But inside, there was an invisible spirit......!

An earthbound spirit after a regrettable death, a spirit with a grudge on the person in the picture, sometimes a guardian angel, and even things that are not a spirit......

Now let’s hold up your spiritual-vision-smartphone, and open your eyes to the existence of the hidden spirits...!
There must be a terrifying experience waiting for you......

If you get scared easily and are playing alone, beware and make sure to light up the room and take a bath before you play the game...!

70010000074218.name: Witch's Potion: Water Sort Puzzle
70010000074218.intro:
Puzzle it out to satisfaction! Can't stop!?
A puzzle game of aligning water colors in a bottle.
70010000074218.description:
With an ultra-simple rule and control!
This is a puzzle game where you switch the water in the bottles to match the colors.
Seems easy but hard? Looks hard but easy!
A total of 1,000 brain-stimulating challenges for you.
Perfect for your spare time, but once you start, you can't stop!?

●How to Play
・Select a bottle and switch the water.
・You can move the water to another bottle with the same color at the top.
・You can move any color of water to an empty bottle.
・You cannot move water to a full bottle.
・When all the water colors in the bottles are aligned, you clear the stage.


●Support Features
With the support functions, there's no problem you can't solve!

・Redo Water Transfer
Don't worry if you make mistakes!
You can redo the water transfer up to 9 times.

・Water Replacement
Don't worry if you get stuck!
By replacing the water in the bottle, you can resolve the situation where water cannot be moved.

・Puzzle Initialization
When in trouble, start from the beginning!
It returns the water arrangement to the initial state.


●Aim for the Gold Medal!
If you clear without stalling from the initial puzzle layout, you can earn a gold medal.
Let's aim for a gold medal in all stages!

70010000074222.name: Full of Crap
70010000074222.intro:
Oh. My feces got mixed in with the curry.
But I'm very hungry...
Let's just finish the curry and eat it!
70010000074222.description:
Can you avoid poop and eat curry?
Let's have fun with a simple and clear game, "Eat Curry while avoiding feces"!

In this game, you eat curry without feces while avoiding curry with feces in it.
Watch your opponent's behavior and eat as many poop-free curries as you can.

You can tell if a card in the field is poop or not by looking at one card in the field (it is OK to tell a lie!).
Choose one type of curry that has more than 3 curries in the field, and turn over the cards one by one, and the game ends when 3 curries are eaten or poop is found.

The player who eats the most curry and gets the highest score wins!

Up to 4 players can play together!

70010000074243.name: BIG BALL SPORTS
70010000074243.intro: Experience sports in a whole new dimension with Big Ball Sports!
70010000074243.description:
This game contains 6 popular sports: soccer, volleyball, dodgeball, kickball, tennis, and golf!
But there's a unqiue twist: in Big Ball Sports, the ball is bigger than you!
This oversized ball offers players unpredictable and wild moments, making gameplay even more fun and challenging! 
Regular rules taking on new meanings as you test your sports skills in games sure to bring smiles and excitement!
It's a sports party game that offers easy controls and big fun for everyone!

In Big Ball Sports, enjoy the following 6 sports:
【Soccer】
Aim for your opponent's goal with a gigantic soccer ball and make a miraculous score!

【Volleyball】
Experience the fun and thrill of volleyball by sending a large ball flying over the net to your opponent.

【Dodgeball】
Throw a large ball at your opponents and engage in action-packed dodgeball battles.

【Kickball】
A fusion of baseball and soccer, enjoy a new sports experience kicking a big ball.

【Tennis】
Feel the tension of tennis as you challenge your opponent with a large tennis ball.

【Golf】
Drive a big golf ball onto the course, aiming for a hole-in-one. The challenge of golf awaits!

70010000074250.name: The Artist Colors
70010000074250.intro: Poetry, painters, colors and animated interactive elements: the ideal educational fun! Plus, it's so easy to use that your little ones will be able to explore it without hassle.
70010000074250.description:
Can you imagine a book that is like a magical journey through art and colors for the little ones at home? This interactive book is the perfect mix of fun, learning and relaxation. Poems about famous painters and main colors, narrated in English and Spanish, will take the little ones into a world of creativity and knowledge.

But that's not all, they also include soothing melodies and relaxing sounds! Ideal for bedtime. And if your kids want to play, we have fun interactions with sounds for them! How about painting with a super-simple magic painting mode? 

Plus, this book is like an artistic time machine, with 7 artists from different eras - want to know more? It's 100% touch screen compatible, so little ones can explore without hassle.

Fun for the whole family is guaranteed! Immerse yourself in a world of poetry, colors and art, and take your little ones on an interactive journey they'll never forget.

70010000074263.name: True Colours - A Date With Deception
70010000074263.intro: Play the villain or seek ultimate redemption in a romantic visual novel adventure!
70010000074263.description:
When three new hires join the office, love is in the air! Take the role of a gender-neutral protagonist that represents every player and make key decisions about work, life and love to guide the story’s development. Get to know your coworkers, go on dates and discover what innermost secrets they could be hiding. Engage in deep, sometimes disarming dialogue and enjoy a wide variety of backdrops and CG scenes.

True Colours – A Date With Deception starts as a cute visual novel about day-to-day life and the pursuit of happiness beyond a boring work routine, but as interpersonal trust is called into question, a darker side begins to emerge. Be forewarned that you could be seen as the villain of this tangled web, but it’s up to you whether you embrace the role or seek ultimate redemption. Dare to explore multiple story routes and romantic interests leading to 12 possible endings, some good… and some very bad!

Features:

• Play as a gender-neutral protagonist and decide what kind of person you want to be!
• Go on dates and socialize with coworkers as you learn about those surrounding you.
• Make key decisions that impact the narrative and certain characters’ development!
• Choose to be the villain of the story or seek a path of redemption.
• Explore a dozen possible endings and unlock CG scenes along the way!

70010000074275.name: Pretty Girls Klondike Solitaire PLUS
70010000074275.intro: Show off your quick-thinking skills as you play through card-based solitaire with a cast of lovely companions!
70010000074275.description:
The Pretty Girls series returns with an expanded take on a timeless classic!

Pretty Girls Klondike Solitaire PLUS offers the same card-based solitaire rules you know and love, but this time, you’ll meet a huge variety of 11 female challengers and enjoy even more gameplay options to customize the experience. Choose from multiple difficulties, play through a tutorial to learn or refresh your knowledge of the game, use hints and assists, change the number of deck draws and more!

Create your own custom dioramas from the characters, clothing and backgrounds you’ve earned! There’s so much here to keep you coming back for quality time with these lovely ladies, all voiced in Japanese.

Features:

• Enjoy classic, endlessly replayable card-based solitaire with klondike rules!
• Quickly chain your card moves to create combos and raise your score.
• Meet a cast of 11 female companions, all voiced in Japanese!
• Choose from multiple difficulties and use assists when you’re in trouble.
• Unlock new outfits to use in the Dressing Room and assemble custom dioramas!

70010000074280.name: Take It Racing 2
70010000074280.intro: Pseudo-racing game for a retro console. Win races, buy cars, level up!
70010000074280.description:
Take It Racing 2 is a pseudo racing game built around stats. Buy better cars to race harder races to earn more money. Each race is split into sections, you must decide how to race to shave off precious time and win the upper hand. But keep an eye on your fuel and temperature gauges or you might be left eating dust!
Starting with the team leader Rob Trader, you begin your racing career in Class D. Wining races earns you money to buy new cars and enter harder races.

A nostalgic experience that can also be played in vertical mode with touch controls to better match the 90's feeling! Play with classic green color mode, choose between multiple color palettes or play with full colored mode!

70010000074282.name: Neon Drifter - Cyber Racing
70010000074282.intro: Speed through a Neon-drenched cyberpunk world: Dominate the streets and master the art of drifting in a futuristic showdown!
70010000074282.description:
Welcome to the neon-drenched streets of the future in "Neon Drifter - Cyber Racing,» the electrifying racing game designed exclusively for Nintendo Switch™! Immerse yourself in a cyberpunk world where speed is king and style is everything. Choose from a lineup of 10 futuristic cyberpunk cars, each with its own distinct speed values and jaw-dropping design that reflects the essence of the neon-soaked metropolis.
   Race Through the Cyberpunk City:
 Get behind the wheel and navigate the dazzling urban landscapes on three uniquely challenging tracks. Each track is a thrilling journey through cyberpunk architecture, offering a visual feast for your eyes. The graphics of Neon Drifter - Cyber Racing are beyond compare, boasting stunning reflections and dynamic lighting that elevate the futuristic cityscape to a whole new level.
   Master the Art of Drifting:
 Feel the adrenaline rush as you drift through the city streets, showcasing your skills and leaving a trail of neon in your wake. The gameplay in Neon Drifter - Cyber Racing is all about precision and style. 
   Unlock the Future of Racing:
 The race for supremacy is on, and it's time to unlock the full potential of your racing experience. Progress through the game and unlock all 10 futuristic cyberpunk cars, each offering a unique blend of speed, handling, and design. As you collect and upgrade your cars, you'll feel the power at your fingertips, pushing the limits of speed and style.
   Multiplayer Mayhem:
 Challenge your friends to intense multiplayer races and settle the score on the neon-lit tracks. With the Nintendo Switch™ 's versatility, you can experience the thrill of competition anytime, anywhere. Neon Drifter - Cyber Racing is not just a solo journey—it's a multiplayer showdown where friendships are tested on the neon battleground.
 Highlights:
• 10 Futuristic Cyberpunk Cars with Unique Designs
• 3 Unique and Challenging Tracks
• Spectacular Graphics with Reflections and Lighting
• Master the Art of Drifting for Racing Dominance
• Unlock and Upgrade Your Fleet of Cyberpunk Cars
• Multiplayer Mode for Thrilling Friend-vs-Friend Races
Gear up, hit the accelerator, and become the Neon Drifter - Cyber Racing champion. The future of racing is now in your hands!

70010000074289.name: Found it!
70010000074289.intro:
Find the one place odd one out!
Brain training spot-the-difference game to train agility
70010000074289.description:
This is a spot-the-difference game where you can easily train your brain by finding one different icon among many icons within the time limit.

Easy-to-play
・Look carefully at the picture
・Touch it within the time limit as you find one of the mistakes!

Even though it seems to be easy if you look carefully, it’s surprisingly difficult when you have a time limit!? So quickly you can play, it’s a perfect game to pass the time.

If you just can’t figure out, press the Hint button!
It will roughly tell you where it is.

70010000074294.name: Warzone Chronicles: Virtual Warfare Shooter
70010000074294.intro: Survive the Unforgiving Horde: Uncover, Strategize, and Outlast!
70010000074294.description:
Warzone Chronicles: Virtual Warfare Shooter immerses you in a gripping struggle for survival, where the only certainty is the ceaseless advance of the undead. The abandoned building, a desolate playground for the apocalypse, becomes the stage for your desperate struggle.
   The map, though small, is a labyrinth of danger and opportunity. Weapons, carefully hidden in the shadows, become your lifeline as you face off against increasingly formidable waves of zombies. The thrill of discovery intertwines with the constant threat of the unknown, creating an atmosphere of suspense that keeps you on the edge of your seat.
   The post-processing effects, reminiscent of a gritty VHS recording, immerse you in a world that feels both raw and authentic. The fish-eye lens adds a surreal touch, amplifying the tension as you navigate the narrow hallways and dimly lit rooms.
   This short yet intense game delivers an unforgettable experience where every shot, every decision, and every narrow escape is etched into the annals of your own personal Warzone Chronicle. 
Key Features of Warzone Chronicles: Virtual Warfare Shooter:
 • Intense Survival Gameplay: Face relentless waves of zombies in a compact, abandoned building, requiring quick thinking and strategic movement.
 • Hidden Weapons: Uncover an arsenal of diverse weapons strategically placed throughout the map, each offering a unique advantage in the fight for survival.
 • Resource Management: Zombies drop health and ammo, forcing players to make tactical decisions on the fly to stay alive and keep the onslaught at bay.
 •  Immersive Visuals: Experience the apocalypse through a nostalgic lens with VHS camera effects and a fish-eye perspective, adding a unique and gritty atmosphere.
   How long can you survive in this nightmarish arena? The answer lies within the decaying walls of the abandoned building, waiting to be uncovered.

70010000074298.name: MechanixMind: IQ Puzzle Adventure
70010000074298.intro: Dive into a world where physics reigns and every level offers endless possibilities.
70010000074298.description:
Step into the captivating universe of MechanixMind: IQ Puzzle Adventure, where the boundaries of physics and creativity merge into one! With no singular path to victory, every level challenges your intellect and beckons your imagination.

Features:Endless Solutions: No two solutions are the same. It's not about finding 'a' solution, it's about crafting 'your' solution.
Minimalist Design: With just two fundamental shapes - a rectangle and a circle - simplicity never felt so complex.
Engaging Physics: Experience real-world physics with a twist. The unpredictable nature of our levels ensures hours of brain-teasing fun.
Relaxing Soundtrack: Lose yourself in the soothing ambiance of our background score, making for a calming yet challenging gameplay experience.
Regular Updates: Fresh levels and challenges added regularly, keeping your creativity on its toes.

Can You Think Outside the Box?
In the world of MechanixMind: IQ Puzzle Adventure, it's not about conforming to predefined solutions. It's about breaking the mold, exploring every nook and cranny of your mind, and proving that with simple shapes, come endless possibilities.

Join a global community of thinkers, challenge the norms, and discover a puzzle game that’s as limitless as your imagination. Welcome to MechanixMind: IQ Puzzle Adventure. Your canvas of creativity awaits.

70010000074303.name: Drag Racing Car Simulator
70010000074303.intro: Are you ready to prove your skills and become the ultimate racing champion?
70010000074303.description:
Gear up for the ultimate racing experience in "Drag Racing Car Simulators," the heart-pounding 3D racing game that puts you in the driver's seat of high-octane, customizable cars. It's not just about speed; it's about mastering the art of precision gear shifting to leave your rivals in the dust.

Key Features:
-Precision Gear Shifting: Show off your expert timing and reflexes by shifting gears at the perfect moment. The right gear change can mean the difference between victory and defeat.

-Intense 3D Racing: Immerse yourself in stunning 3D environments that come to life with realistic graphics and dynamic physics. Race through diverse landscapes, from city streets to winding mountain roads.

-Car Customization: Earn money by winning races and use it to buy new, high-performance cars or upgrade your current one. Customize your vehicle's appearance and performance to suit your style and strategy.

-Compete Against Rivals: Face off against skilled AI opponents who will challenge your racing abilities at every turn. Conquer multiple racing modes, including time trials, circuits, and more.

-Realistic Driving Physics: Feel the thrill of the race with true-to-life driving physics that offer an authentic racing experience.

-Adrenaline-Pumping Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the action with a high-energy soundtrack that intensifies the racing experience.

Are you ready to prove your skills and become the ultimate racing champion? Get behind the wheel, master the art of gear shifting, and leave your rivals in the dust. "Drag Racing Car Simulator" offers an exhilarating racing experience that combines precision, strategy, and speed. Can you handle the challenge and emerge as the racing champion of this adrenaline-fueled world?

70010000074308.name: Tengoku Struggle -Strayside-
70010000074308.description:
From the team that created Olympia Soirée comes a comedic battle fantasy set in a place where the living and the dead mingle, and sinners are pitted against each other in eternal battle. 

Rin Enma, adopted daughter of the king of the underworld, has been tasked with tracking down and recapturing a group of escaped sinners. 

Accompanying her on her journey are four sinners hand-picked by her father. Will Rin succeed in her mission… and will she discover love?

70010000074310.name: Virche Evermore -EpiC: Lycoris-
70010000074310.description:
The small country of Arpéchéle is surrounded by the sea and filled with black flowers known as Lycoris Noirges. Every island resident is cursed to die at the age of 23. 

Many years of research have led to the creation of a “memory download” system, allowing the body to die while memories live on in a clone known as a “Reliver”.

The original story of Virche Evermore -ErroR: Salvation- followed a girl known as “Death” who brought an early end to any person she was involved with. With the assistance of others, she was able to discover the truth behind some of the dark workings on the island.

This fan disk allows you to explore five unique, all-new tales.

70010000074312.name: Radiant Tale -Fanfare!-
70010000074312.description:
An unlikely group of performers makes a last-ditch effort to reform a failing circus: a crazy dragon, a somber clown, a hesitant magician, an acrobat who can’t entertain, and a reluctant ringleader.

Radiant Tale introduced Tifalia, a bright new producer who does her best to turn this dysfunctional troupe around and make them stars. 

Radiant Tale -Fanfare!- contains three all-new play modes with fresh stories and new routes with two side characters, enhancing the complete adventure!

70010000074314.name: Brawl.io 2
70010000074314.intro: Destroy, build tactics, and destroy as many enemies as possible on your way!
70010000074314.description: In Brawl.io 2 you can use superpowers to attack, get new skins, go forward and destroy as many players as possible during the match!

70010000074325.name: Fastest Finger First! 3 Hint Quiz
70010000074325.intro:
Find the Common Link Among Three Clues!
A Fast-Paced Quiz Game Also Supporting Japanese & Korean
70010000074325.description:
This is a fast-paced quiz game where you guess what the three sequentially revealed clues represent as time progresses.
Playing is simple:

Read the hints displayed on the screen carefully and think about their common link.
Once you figure it out, press the answer button and input your answer.
Depending on how quickly you figure it out, you'll be rated with 1 to 3 stars.
It supports both Japanese and Korean, making it ideal for language learning!
Aim for 3 stars in all languages and stages.

70010000074332.name: Suika Game
70010000074332.intro: To prevent the fruits from overflowing from the box,  collide the same kind of fruit. As you collide fruits, their types change. Let's create big watermelons!
70010000074332.description: This is a game where you combine two small fruits to make them larger and create big watermelons.

70010000074339.name: Sphinx - Riddles of the Nile
70010000074339.intro: Discover the secrets of the Nile and solve over 500 fascinating puzzles in the magical world of ancient Egypt
70010000074339.description:
Embark on an epic journey to the heart of ancient Egypt in "Sphinx - Riddles of the Nile." Immerse yourself in a mesmerizing world of mysticism and challenge as you unravel the enigmatic puzzles of the Sphinx.

Key Features:

- 500+ Levels of Mind-Bending Puzzles: With over 500 levels, "Sphinx - Riddles of the Nile" offers endless hours of classic Sokoban-style gameplay. Push gemstones through intricate, brain-teasing layouts, each more challenging than the last.

- Ancient Egyptian Adventure: Explore a stunning 3D environment inspired by the timeless beauty of ancient Egypt.

- Top-Down Perspective: With a top-down 3D perspective, you'll have a clear view of each level's intricacies, enabling you to plan your moves strategically.

- Challenging and Relaxing: "Sphinx - Riddles of the Nile" offers a relaxed gaming experience with a simple rule set and a focus on mental acuity. It's a perfect game for casual gamers and puzzle enthusiasts alike.

70010000074347.name: Shanghai Summer
70010000074347.description:
Shanghai Summer is an adventure game set in the millennium. Our protagonist, Baichuan, goes through a series of "anomalies" over the length of twelve days. In his pursuit of the truth, he found that his hopes and regrets from the past finally seem to converge. Will he be able to "fix" it for good?

The Story

Shanghai, 2003

Suddenly, Baichuan senses something is not right with his life - sometimes, he feels he can see his memories, so real yet so unfamiliar. This all seems to begin with an unexpected invitation from Baichuan's ex-girlfriend, Qiuyu, who has been away for many years.

Twelve summer days, just like twelve lucid dreams...

"The time seems to be working anomalously on you."

The Characters

Dream-chasing, freelancer artist - Fengyi;
Troubled and misguided high school student - Xiaobo;
A university student who is burdened by her family's issue - Jingxian.
......

Even though their lives are a total mess, they still manage to carry on, embrace and accept their "regrets", and live to the fullest.

The Gameplay

Through the 'Topics' and 'Clues' gathered from everyday life, dive deep into the hearts and minds of your dearest friends.

To be comforted by them; To be inspired by them; To turn all the little things that happened in your life into your own strength, and eventually, at the finale of the twelfth night – 

To " fix" the shattered dream.

The Stages

Classrooms, Bookstore "What-If", Neighbourhood Cafe...

Much of every boy and girl's life revolves around such a mundane city scene. And it is precisely within the mundanity that some new possibilities exist. The key to turning one's fate around may very much be held in the hand of someone passing by among the crowds on the streets...

70010000074355.name: ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN DELUXE EDITION
70010000074355.description:
With over 5 million copies sold worldwide, ACE COMBAT™7: SKIES UNKNOWN, the best-selling game in the ACE COMBAT series, is finally available on Nintendo Switch™!

Become an ace pilot and take to photo-realistic skies in the ultimate flight and combat simulator series: ACE COMBAT.
Nothing beats the feeling of soaring through the air with 360 degrees of freedom, relying on your flying and fighting instincts to take down the enemy, overcome tense situations, and become the hero.

Based on the theme of aerial innovation, the latest installment boasts the most spectacular aerial combat yet, taking you through cloud-filled skies and intricate landscapes to enjoy some of the most high-speed and captivating aerial combat in the series' history.

Includes:
- Three original aircraft sets and three SP Missions
1) ADF-11F Raven Set
2) ADF-01 FALKEN Set
3) ADFX-01 Morgan Set
4) SP MISSION 01 - Unexpected Visitor
5) SP MISSION 02 - Anchorhead Raid
6) SP MISSION 03 - Ten Million Relief Plan
- (Bonus) Music Player Mode
- Playable F-104C -Avril- aircraft
*An F-104C that Avril and her old man rescued from an aircraft graveyard and spent over eight years restoring. With not a single weapon equipped, this aircraft can only be used in Free Flight mode.
*A regular F-104C equipped with weapons is included in the main game.
- Playable F-4E Phantom II aircraft
- 3 popular aircraft skins from past titles
- 8 popular emblems from past titles

70010000074357.name: GRADIUS ORIGINS
70010000074357.intro: The legendary pioneer of side-scrolling shoot 'em genre makes a triumphant return!
70010000074357.description:
This collection features 18 versions across all 7 arcade titles in the series, including the first-ever appearance of Gradius III AM Show Version on home consoles.

A variety of helpful new features have been added to the games, including save states, a rewind feature, and Invincible Mode. The new Training Mode lets you adjust settings like restart points, loop counts, and power-up statuses to help hone your skills to perfection. There's also a gallery feature that includes music from the game, a variety of images from each title, and much, much more!

1. SALAMANDER III

2. GRADIUS
 JP ROM Ver. / JP Bubble Ver. / NA Ver. (NEMESIS) / EU Ver. (NEMESIS) / NA Prototype (NEMESIS)

3. SALAMANDER
 JP Ver. / NA Ver.(LIFE FORCE)

4. LIFE FORCE
 JP Ver.

5. GRADIUS II: GOFER no Yabou
 JP Early Ver. / JP Mid Ver. / JP Late Ver. / NA Ver.(VULCAN VENTURE)

6. GRADIUS III: Densetsu kara Shinwa e
 JP Old Ver. / JP New Ver. / Asia Ver. / JP AM Show Ver.

7. SALAMANDER2
 JP Ver.

■ New modes, support features, and quality of life improvements

Quicksave / Quickload
 Save and load your game data at any point during gameplay.

Rewind
 Rewind your gameplay whenever and wherever you want during a game.

Easy Mode
 This mode makes the game easier to play by reducing the size of your ship's hitbox.

Invincible Mode
 This mode makes your ship impervious to enemy fire and only counts the number of times you were hit.

Training Mode
 This mode lets you hone your skills by adjusting settings such as restart points, loop counts, and power-up statuses.
 * This mode is only available in certain game versions.

Online Rankings
 Add your score to the leaderboards after getting a game over.
 Earn a top ranking to upload a replay of your game along with your score.

Sound Gallery
 Listen to the original soundtrack from each title as well as arrangements from previously released CD albums.

Visual Gallery
 View the games' original instruction cards and developmental resources.

Gradius Guide
 Check your scores and a gallery of enemy characters from each of the original titles.


You can also adjust various settings from each game's Options screen, including arcade board DIP switches, screen filters, and a recreation of software bugs from the original release.

70010000074367.name: Coloring book series Zoo
70010000074367.intro:
Popular coloring game is back.
Come see your favorite ZOO animals!
70010000074367.description:
This coloring is the ideal way to learn about ZOO animals and have fun coloring!
Get access to more than 150 new pictures including African Elephant, Moose, Alpaca, and Quokka.
They are all waiting to be brought to life in your color!

■Coloring has never been easier!
All you need to do is tap the screen, so everyone can easily handle various types of tools and enjoy coloring.

■Build your own gallery!
You can also exhibit your finished colorings in your gallery and enjoy them with family.
Even if your child is not reading yet, you can show the collection and read the name to your child so they can begin identifying the animals!

70010000074376.name: Master Ninja - Shuriken Killer
70010000074376.intro: Dive into the world of ninjas and prove yourself as the ultimate ninja master in this action-packed game!
70010000074376.description:
Welcome to the mysterious and action-packed world of Master Ninja - Shuriken Killer! In this thrilling game, you will step into the shoes of a skilled ninja, ready to put your skills to the test in battles against the most formidable enemies. 
      Game Modes:
• Classic Mode - Experience traditional ninja battles, perfect your shuriken skills and defeat enemies in a classic battle setting.
• Bomb Mode - Take control of powerful bombs with an adjustable fire radius, adding an explosive twist to your ninja arsenal.
• Hostage Mode - Test your accuracy and decision making as you rescue hostages while eliminating enemies. Challenge yourself by making sure you don't harm the hostages while taking down your enemies.
• Friendly Fire Mode - Engage in shuriken projectile combat against enemies, but now, be careful as you have the potential to get hurt. Stay alive in this challenging mode.
       Master your ninja skills, unlock game modes with a variety of different maps, and collect stars as you embark on an exciting adventure filled with obstacles, enemies, and hostages.

70010000074380.name: Truckzilla - Monster Truck Mega Ramp
70010000074380.intro: Unleash Your Inner Beast in Truckzilla - The Ramp Mania Begins!
70010000074380.description:
Embark on a heart-pounding adventure with our newest release, Truckzilla - Monster Truck Mega Ramp! Dive into a realm of high-speed thrills and mind-boggling stunts as you take the reins of the mightiest monster trucks.
   Key Features:
• Thrilling Action: Feel the rush of speed as you navigate through challenging ramps and obstacles.
• Magical Crystal Collection: Collect mystical crystals scattered along your path to earn awesome bonuses.
• Customise with Unique Skins: Stand out in the arena with our unique sticker collection system. Upgrade your stickers to unlock a variety of extraordinary skins for your monster truck.
• Special Missions and Exciting Rewards: Challenge your abilities by completing special missions to claim thrilling rewards.
   With Truckzilla, your goal is to unlock all the exclusive skins for your vehicle and create the coolest garage ever seen. Hone your skills, compete with the best, and become a legendary monster truck racer.

70010000074388.name: Anglerfish
70010000074388.intro: Go on an epic adventure equipped only with your shotgun, wit, and a strong stomach for disturbing exploration. The game only saves when you die. Can you survive a night?
70010000074388.description:
Welcome to Anglerfish. 
Your secluded bar in Mols mountains. Here you will experience the true survival horror of dating, which means you will die. 

...you will die multiple times...
...you will die many, many times.
 
And every time you die, you have to start over but here’s the catch - the game changes, based on how and where you died to keep you on your toes. To make it through the night, you must uncover the secrets hidden deep down in Anglerfish’s core by exploring every nook and cranny, and solve the buried mysteries. 
Can you survive your wildest night ever at Anglerfish?

FEATURES:
♡ Memento Mori - The only way to save is to die.
♡ Till Death Do Us Part - Every time you die, the game adapts, keeping things fresh
♡ It’s A Beautiful Life - Distractingly beautiful pixel art graphics
♡ What’s So Funny? - Dark humor that will keep you sane or do the exact opposite
♡ Oh, Shoot - Experience high-octane survival horror gameplay with your trusty shotgun
♡ Everything You Just Read Is False - Or is it?

REVIEWS:
▪ "This game is just a treat, a great mix of horror, comedy, and keeping you on your toes.” - KatLink
▪ "Excellent game, the core mechanic of changing things up each time works well. I really liked the 'difficulty' scaling too.” - Ahegoa
▪ "Holy hell this game is great. It's weird, it's funny, it's all that a game should be.” - AC

70010000074395.name: OrbWars
70010000074395.description:
A young child's bedroom has been taken over by the evil Monster in the Dark and it's army of corrupted toys. Only the OrbWarriors, a small group of heroic toy robots, have the courage and strength to stand up for justice and fight! Take control of your favourite OrbWarrior either alone or together as up to 4 players and enjoy fast paced, but strategic roguelite action coop! 

- Utilize your iconic weapon, the Orb, and become a master of its chaotic fighting style! 

- Power up your Orbs even more by picking up OrbBoosts - skill capsules that enhance and sometimes change your skills entirely, from causing fiery explosions and poison trails, to laser traps and placing automatic sentry turrets!

- Collect experience and level up your OrbWarrior's abilities with powerful new skills and stat increases!

- Each run is different thanks to randomly generated levels and rewards! Prove your adaptability and overcome even the toughest of challenges on the fly!

70010000074404.name: Spacefarer Solitaire
70010000074404.intro: Spacefarer Solitaire is a beautifully designed and animated classic game for Nintendo Switch™, with excellent replay value.
70010000074404.description: Spacefarer Solitaire is a beautifully designed and animated classic game for Nintendo Switch™, with excellent replay value. Aimed at hobbyists and causal players alike!

70010000074406.name: Spacefarer Mahjong
70010000074406.intro: Spacefarer Mahjong is a classic Mahjong game with multiple play modes and styles.
70010000074406.description: Spacefarer Mahjong is a classic Mahjong game with multiple play modes, styles and presented in beautiful graphics and features relaxing music which will keep hobbyists or casual players going for ages!

70010000074408.name: Re:Cento
70010000074408.intro:
New concept of solitaire! 
The cards are simply numbered 1 to 100.
70010000074408.description:
This is the digital version of a catchy card game called ‘Re: Cento’ designed by Inaba Naoki, world famouse as the inovator of Area Maze puzzles.

■The game is both simple and exciting!
Like ‘Old Maid’, you draw a card from the player to your left but where it gets exciting is you can force opponents to pick up cards while avoiding having cards forced into your hand. 
The player who empties his/her hand first wins.

■It requires memory, logical thinking, and good luck to win.

■Basic Rules
Step1. On your turn, you draw a card from the player to your left and place the card face up on the table. 
Step2. Then you place a card from your hand on the table. 
Step3. The other players can place cards which have numbers between those two cards on the table. You have to receive the cards placed on the table by the other players. 
Step4. It is now the next player’s turn. In this way the game continues, the player who empties his/her hand first is the winner.

Give it a try and you will soon get the hang of it.

70010000074415.name: Tennis Tournament Hyper-Casual
70010000074415.description:
Immerse yourself in the exciting world of our competitions, where precious trophies - cups - are at stake! Exciting tournaments consisting of three intense matches await you. However, be careful, because if you lose, the score is reset to zero and you start over. The competition ends as soon as you or your opponent reaches 3 points. But victory is not the end! An exciting bonus scene awaits you where you can collect precious diamonds.

And that is not all! There are over 20 unique characters available in the store, each with their own unique skills and abilities. Choose your hero and join the battle for the cup!

70010000074419.name: Zombies, Aliens and Guns
70010000074419.intro: A horde of invaders is coming for Earth, and a bunch of soldiers are ready to fight back
70010000074419.description:
Aliens have attacked the planet, and they’re turning innocent people into mindless zombies. 
		
It won’t be long before the invaders have destroyed the planet unless somebody with guns stands in their way. That’s where you come in! Lead a cadre of soldiers who are ready to take down every last enemy in their path. 

You can fight alone or with a friend thanks to the local co-op mode! Try to beat the 33 levels and unlock all the 7 survival levels and the boss rush mode!


Features:
* 33 levels of carnage
* 7 survival levels and boss rush mode
* 2.5D shooting action gameplay
* Variety of terrain and scenarios
* Multiple weapons
* Boss battles

70010000074422.name: Girl Dress Up Classic
70010000074422.intro: Welcome to the exciting world of fashion, style and creativity!
70010000074422.description:
In this exciting game for girls, you can paint your dreams in bright colors, creating unique looks and turning every day into a real fashion holiday.

Game Features:

Huge selection of clothes: A huge wardrobe with endless combinations of stylish outfits, accessories, shoes and makeup awaits you. You can create hundreds of unique looks that express your personality.

Stylish Hairstyles and Makeup: You can experiment with different hairstyles and makeup options to create a look that will highlight your uniqueness and beauty.

Inspiration and creativity: The game will allow you to develop your taste and sense of style, as well as be inspired to create your own fashion looks in real life.

Prepare yourself for an exciting journey into the world of fashion and style. Create, explore and share your unique looks. Girl Dress Up Classic is a game that will make you feel like a real fashion star!

70010000074424.name: Official Spacefarer Card Game
70010000074424.intro: Battle against AI with a traditional elemental based card game featuring Spacefarer Characters!
70010000074424.description:
Introducing the Official Spacefarer Card Game!
Featuring decks from Spacefarer games, including The Dawning Clocks of Time, amazin' George, Jacob's Quest, SHIMAZU and amazin' Mage, battle against AI with a traditional elemental based team.
-Score points in two rounds to beat your opponent. Each card is worth different points!
-Keep on dealing cards from your hand in a fast battle of wits!
-Featuring wonderful animations and smooth transitions of play, just like a real card game.
-Fair and balanced play between playing different decks.

70010000074457.name: VALIS: The Fantasm Soldier Collection III
70010000074457.intro:
The battle of the maidens transcends time.
The legendary beautiful girl action, a culmination of revival!
70010000074457.description:
The legend of Valis reaches its pinnacle here!!
The third installment in the highly acclaimed 'Valis: The Fantasm Soldier' reissue series has arrived. This edition finally includes the popular titles 'Valis: The Fantasm Soldier (PC-88 version)' and 'VALIS: The Fantasm Soldier (Family Computer version),' which had particularly high demand for a reissue. Furthermore, the collection boasts a substantial volume with a total of five titles, adding 'Valis: The Fantasm Soldier II (MSX2),' 'VALIS III (MEGA DRIVE),' and 'SUPER VALIS IV.' This is the ultimate culmination of the Valis revival, a must-have for Valis and retro game fans.

■ A popular game supported by many passionate fans
The 'Valis: The Fantasm Soldier' series is a side-scrolling action game released as a PC game in 1986. The unique world where a high school girl in a sailor uniform and bikini armor battles demons, along with its solid action and story, captured the hearts of many game fans. This led to the production of numerous sequels and ports to other platforms. Even now, over 35 years since its inception, it remains a title supported by fans both in Japan and abroad.

■ Play Valis to the fullest with additional features for Nintendo Switch™!
In addition to the appreciation mode that allows you to fully enjoy the BGM and visual scenes, synonymous with the Valis series, there are additional features that let you thoroughly enjoy the charm of Valis. These include indispensable save and load functions for game strategy, and a 'rewind' feature that lets you go back and try again if you make a mistake.

70010000074461.name: Anime Tank Blitz: Warbound Legends
70010000074461.description:
"Anime Tank Blitz: Warbound Legends" invites you to enter a dynamic world of tank battles presented in a captivating comic-style format. 
In this game, you'll have the opportunity to enhance your tanks, explore three distinct battlefield maps, and wield an impressive array of abilities, including deploying mini tanks, setting tricky mine traps, activating powerful turrets, and even taking to the skies in miniature airplanes.

Strategically, "Anime Tank Blitz: Warbound Legends " empowers you to lead your team by making critical decisions on which enemy tank to target next. This level of control and tactical depth adds an exciting layer to each battle.

MAIN FEATURES:
- Tank Customization: Allow players to personalize by upgrading their tanks with various skins, armaments, and equipment, providing a unique gameplay experience.
- Diverse Maps: Include a range of maps with different terrains and challenges, such as urban environments, industrial location and forest.
- Realistic Physics: Implement realistic tank physics to enhance gameplay and provide an authentic tank-driving experience.
- Variety of Tanks: Include a wide selection of historically accurate tanks from different eras, each with its own set of abilities, strengths and weaknesses.
- Realistic Sound and Graphics: Use high-quality graphics and sound effects to immerse players in the tank warfare experience.
- Matchmaking: Include a balanced matchmaking system to ensure fair and challenging battles.

Prepare to take command of your tanks, upgrade your arsenal, and lead your team to victory in this thrilling comic-style battlefield.

70010000074465.name: nGolf
70010000074465.intro: Set off on the most engaging golf adventure you have ever seen and visit breathtaking places from around the world.
70010000074465.description:
Grab your equipment with you and begin your journey to become a master of nGolf. Explore beautiful and minimalist locations full of traps, puzzles, and amazing views.


FIND YOUR WAY
While playing nGolf you will face many challenges on your way. Lasers, spikes, flames and many more will try to stop your ball. Remember that timing is the key to success and you shouldn’t hurry with your hit. Go with the flow and master all worlds.


PLAN YOUR APPROACH
There is an unlimited number of possible solutions to finish levels. Different angles and strengths can change the trajectory of the ball diametrically. Check your surroundings for hills, teleports, or speed boosters. Each element gives you a new opportunity to hit the hole. 


BECOME A GOLF MASTER
To become a professional, you have to collect all stars on each stage and accomplish the lowest amount of hits. Study the layout of the map, take as many attempts as you need and obtain the title of champion!



KEY FEATURES:
- 8 unique worlds
- Over 60 levels to master
- Scorecards to help you track your progress

70010000074470.name: Hentai Golf
70010000074470.intro: Experience the best date ever and become champion in golf with little help from beautiful girls!
70010000074470.description:
Head to the golf course after a hard day at work, and meet three stunning business women: Yumiko, Narumi, Misa and show them how to become a master of the golf field.


SHOW THEM HOW TO DO IT
Pick one of the available golf clubs, choose the direction, feel the wind and swing! Every single factor matters and can decide on your score. Prepare your tactic, check the surroundings and impress girls with your skills. 


DON’T DISTRACT YOURSELF
Girls will watch your every move and as you hit more holes they will feel more comfortable around you. Hopefully it won’t make you lose your focus even for a second. Admire their suits and spend more time with them later in the game menu. 


AUTHENTIC MECHANICS
As every professional, you should use all the information given in order to become a good teacher. Check the direction of wind and its speed. Choose the correct golf club for the situation. Plan your route using minimap and many more!

Remember to avoid tanks of water and use sand piles to stop your ball if necessary.


KEY FEATURES:
- Three amazing girls that will cheer you up after hard day at work
- Classical golf gameplay
- 40 maps with unique layouts
- Energetic soundtrack

70010000074480.name: Knowledge Keeper
70010000074480.intro: Destroy, move and combine objects on the levels to get to divine crystals.

70010000074485.name: Matchbox™ Driving Adventures
70010000074485.intro: Ignite your imagination and jump into your vehicle to tackle missions and win races.
70010000074485.description:
Are you ready for the thrill of a lifetime? Gear up and join the Chief of the Matchbox Adventure Squad in Matchbox™ Driving Adventures. 

Jump into an authentic Matchbox™ vehicle and drive through six dynamic locations. Race against the clock, chase runaway cars, and tackle exciting rescue missions. 

Cruise in Adventure Mode or choose from 14 tracks in Competition Mode for a spot on the leaderboard playing solo or in local co-op. The choice is yours. Earn medals as you unlock 10 customizable vehicles to add to your collection. 

It's time to get behind the wheel of iconic Matchbox™ cars and trucks, celebrate your accomplishments, and Drive Your Adventure.

REAL-WORLD SCENARIOS – Extinguish fires, complete deliveries, or make airport drop-offs.

TAKE THE SCENIC ROUTE – Explore six epic locations: the City Center, Beach, Mountains, Arctic, Jungle, and Volcano.

EQUIP YOUR VEHICLES – Unlock new vehicles and upgrade them with slick paint jobs so you can drive in style. 

DRIVE YOUR ADVENTURE – Complete missions and explore in Adventure Mode or compete in Competition Mode.

70010000074491.name: Hello Kitty Island Adventure
70010000074491.intro: Embark on a cozy adventure with Hello Kitty and Friends and restore an abandoned island to its former glory.
70010000074491.description:
• Discover eight unique regions, from the ocean’s depths to an island in the clouds
•Befriend iconic characters like cheerful Hello Kitty, mischievous Kuromi, and sweet Cinnamoroll
• Bake, cook, and craft the perfect gifts to become best friends
• Renovate cabins and decorate them to attract even more wonderful characters
• Create your perfect avatar, find and customize hundreds of outfits tailored to you, and create and collect furniture to achieve your dream home aesthetic
• Celebrate the joys of summertime, the winter holidays, and more with a year round calendar of events. And don’t forget to throw birthday parties for your friends
• Solve hidden puzzles, catch cute critters, and garden to fill the world with flowers
•Dive into a multiplayer game with real-world friends and family: team up to explore, get bonuses, and take sweet snapshots together

70010000074503.name: Basketball Arcade
70010000074503.description:
How many baskets can you score in 40 seconds?

Basketball Arcade is an addictive game designed for real basketball fans of all ages.

FEATURES:

- 4 balls with different scoring rules
- Bonus round after every 40 points
- Moving hoop in bonus rounds
- Easy to pick up one touch swipe controls
- Realistic physics

70010000074505.name: Chico and the Magic Orchards DX
70010000074505.intro: Solve puzzles by rolling a giant walnut in this retro-handheld-inspired adventure. Explore a variety of levels each with unique mechanics. Help Chico build his winter stash and get home!
70010000074505.description:
When Chico the chubby-cheeked chipmunk stumbles into a portal in the forest, he’s transported to a magical world! Here he finds giant walnuts galore, but getting them home won’t be easy! Solve puzzles and challenges across a variety of unique levels, gather a horde of giant walnuts, and help Chico get back to his forest!

With unique dual-mode gameplay, you’ll have to really use your nut to crack these worlds. Alone, Chico can jump over obstacles and push wall switches. If he has a walnut, he can roll it over spikes, bounce it off of walls and bumpers, and more. Find a way to get the walnut through to the end of the level with you! Each world introduces unique new mechanics that will test your brain and your skills.

Chico and the Magic Orchards is made to evoke 8-bit handheld games. Catchy chiptune music, simple controls, and pixel-grid filters let you feel like you're playing a "lost classic"! Play the game in fixed 4-color mode, automatic palette mode with a special 4-color palette for each area, or the new Full Color mode!

Even after the end credits roll, that's not the end of Chico's adventure! Continue your game after beating it to start playing the new post-game campaign A Hive Divided! Rescue trapped bees across two new giant levels, and defeat the Queen Bee. Power up your walnut with fire, water, and honey for a whole new spin on solving puzzles and exploring areas!

70010000074507.name: Pokémon™ Scarlet + AOC bundle (for GP distribution)
70010000074507.intro: This bundle includes both the Pokémon™ Scarlet game and The Hidden Treasure of Area Zero DLC
70010000074507.description:
Journey through a new, open-world Pokémon™ adventure 

Catch, battle, and train Pokémon in the Paldea region, a vast land filled with lakes, towering peaks, wastelands, small towns, and sprawling cities. Explore a wide-open world at your own pace and traverse land, water, and air by riding on the form-shifting Legendary Pokémon Koraidon. Choose either Sprigatito, Fuecoco, or Quaxly, to be your first partner Pokémon before setting off on your journey through Paldea.

Adventure beyond the Paldea region in The Hidden Treasure of Area Zero DLC

Even more Pokémon, places, and stories await in this 2-part DLC for the Pokémon Scarlet game! In Part 1: The Teal Mask, join a special school trip to the land of Kitakami. In Part 2: The Indigo Disk, study abroad at Blueberry Academy! Encounter the newly-discovered Legendary Pokémon Ogerpon and Terapagos as you broaden your horizons beyond Naranja Academy and explore even more of the Pokémon world.

The following DLC is included:
- Part 1: The Teal Mask: Available September 13th, 2023
- Part 2: The Indigo Disk: Planned release date: Winter 2023

70010000074508.name: Pokémon™ Violet + AOC bundle (for GP distribution)
70010000074508.intro: This bundle includes both the Pokémon™ Violet game and The Hidden Treasure of Area Zero DLC
70010000074508.description:
Journey through a new, open-world Pokémon™ adventure 

Catch, battle, and train Pokémon in the Paldea region, a vast land filled with lakes, towering peaks, wastelands, small towns, and sprawling cities. Explore a wide-open world at your own pace and traverse land, water, and air by riding on the form-shifting Legendary Pokémon Miraidon. Choose either Sprigatito, Fuecoco, or Quaxly, to be your first partner Pokémon before setting off on your journey through Paldea.

Adventure beyond the Paldea region in The Hidden Treasure of Area Zero DLC

Even more Pokémon, places, and stories await in this 2-part DLC for the Pokémon Violet game! In Part 1: The Teal Mask, join a special school trip to the land of Kitakami. In Part 2: The Indigo Disk, study abroad at Blueberry Academy! Encounter the newly-discovered Legendary Pokémon Ogerpon and Terapagos as you broaden your horizons beyond Uva Academy and explore even more of the Pokémon world.

The following DLC is included:
- Part 1: The Teal Mask: Available September 13th, 2023
- Part 2: The Indigo Disk: Planned release date: Winter 2023

70010000074512.name: Muv-Luv Alternative Remastered
70010000074512.intro: Playtime's over. Time for despair. Experience a masterpiece in the Muv-Luv saga's thrilling conclusion.
70010000074512.description:
Muv-Luv Alternative is a direct sequel to Muv-Luv Unlimited, and is the grand finale of the Muv-Luv saga. 
Step back into the cockpit and prepare for deployment in Muv-Luv Alternative, the most critically acclaimed visual novel of all time.
This isn’t a cutesy high school rom-com anymore; it’s an epic tale of conspiracies, an alien menace, quantum causality, and much, much more. It’ll test your limits, challenge your worldview, and by the time it’s all over, you’ll be so emotionally spent that it’ll be weeks before you can fully process the implications of what you’ve just witnessed.
This definitive remastered release comes with a brand-new interface, so if you think you’re ready to take the dive, there’s never been a better time to strap in and see for yourself why so many readers consider this the greatest story ever told.

—-Story—-
Three years have passed since the day Takeru suddenly awoke in a world not his own — a war-torn alternate reality in which mankind was locked in a decades-long struggle against the ruthless extraterrestrial invaders known as the BETA. In that time, he’s been through an awful lot — enlisting in the military, meeting parallel-universe versions of his old friends, and even falling in love. 
But it seems that fate has bigger plans for Takeru, because after a disastrous failure, he wakes up to find himself back in his childhood bedroom once again. Not in his own world, mind you — but back where he was three years prior. This is no dream; this is a recurring nightmare. But then it hits him: this is a second chance. Perhaps he can use his knowledge to warn Professor Kouzuki, and together, they can somehow find a way to prevent Alternative V from ever being enacted. If he can change history, then maybe — just maybe — he’ll find the answers to all of his questions. Why has he gone back in time? Why isn’t Sumika here? And most importantly, what IS Alternative IV?

70010000074515.name: Muv-Luv Remastered
70010000074515.intro: One of the most highly-acclaimed visual novel series ever, now available on Nintendo Switch™!
70010000074515.description:
One of the most influential visual novels of all time, and a school love story like no other. This remastered release comes with a brand new, easy-to-use interface. The game contains the first two arcs: Extra, and Unlimited.
Don’t fall for Extra’s cutesy exterior. This series ventures into some of the darkest thematic territory you’ll ever see, and when the final curtain closes, you’ll need a forklift to pick your jaw up off the floor. Make no mistake: this is a story that will challenge you in ways few works of fiction dare attempt, and an emotional tour de force unlike any other.

----Muv-Luv Extra----
Takeru is your average high school senior whose entire world gets turned upside down one morning when he awakens to find himself in bed with the heiress to one of the world’s largest conglomerates. She calls herself Meiya, and - despite never having met him before - she insists that the two of them are destined for one another. This comes much to the chagrin of his childhood friend Sumika, the girl next door who’s always had feelings for him, who realizes that if she doesn’t act fast, she might just lose him forever. But just who is Meiya? And do his feelings for Sumika run deeper than he thought? In the end, he’ll need to decide between the girl who’s been with him through thick and thin, or the stranger who claims they’re bound together by fate. 
But that’s only one side of the story.

----Muv-Luv Unlimited----
Just as the page turns on Takeru’s happily ever after, he awakens one morning in a world not his own. An alternate timeline, a world infested by alien invaders locked in a war that’s been raging on for decades. And yet, all the set pieces are the same - his house is still here, albeit barely standing. His school is still here, though it’s now a military academy. And even though they don’t recognize him, all his friends are here too... with one exception...

70010000074518.name: Piyokoro
70010000074518.intro:
A new sensation!?
Hit it and let it roll! A rolling puzzle game!
Roll the cute chicks around and aim for the goal!
70010000074518.description:
It's a simple game where you draw your favorite shapes on the screen and aim for the goal.

There are various floors and gimmicks on the stage, and the characters are not only chicks, but also sparrows, penguins, etc.
There are so many characters with different sizes and characteristics that it's fun to watch!
It's fun to roll! It's a game.

=== You can also create your own original stage! ===
Also includes the ability to create your own original stage!

[how to play]
・Create blocks and lines freely by operating gyro of Joy-Con™ or tracing the screen.
・If you hold down the button, you can create a heavy stone statue of a chick.
- Hit the character with blocks and statues and aim for the flag.
・Build a bridge with wire where there is no floor.

Unlimited number of times! 
It's okay no matter how many times you fail.
If the conditions are met, you will be able to select a new character.

70010000074527.name: Twin Mind: Murderous Jealousy Collector's Edition
70010000074527.intro: Can you solve a murder case of Adaline Salfield?
70010000074527.description:
Twin detectives Randall and Eleanor Jones share a passion for justice, but their methods couldn't be more different.
He's the logical, deductive type, while she uses a mystical approach, 
but they'll need to combine their skills when they're called in to investigate an onstage murder at the local theater!
And once they dig into the victim's past, they discover that nothing about this case is as simple as it seems!

The Collector’s Edition includes:
- Find hidden coins, morphing objects, and more to complete your collections!
- Replay your favorite hidden-object scenes and mini-games to unlock challenging achievements!
- Keep the case moving with a strategy guide!

70010000074533.name: Stick to the Plan
70010000074533.intro: In this game you can't pet the dog... because YOU are the dog!
70010000074533.description:
Created by Dead Pixel Tales, Stick to the Plan is a cozy and soothing puzzle game that takes you on a journey with Roberto, as he embarks on a quest to get the perfect stick along the way.

The game is simple: avoid obstacles and chart a path towards the goal. But beware, it's not as easy as it appears. And don't forget to grab your stick!

- Intuitive and accessible controls: move, rotate, pick up & drop your stick in order to solve puzzles.

- Solve about 70 precious levels, each one with its own set of challenges and surprises.

- Immerse yourself in beautiful 3D worlds that have been crafted focusing on detail and enjoy an environmental OST that enhances the experience.

- Accessibility options like outlines for Roberto and the sticks, so everyone can play!

- Enjoy the lovely hand-drawn menus and level selectors while you explore 5 unique worlds

- Uncover the heartwarming story of Roberto through illustrated vignettes, and discover the reason behind his quest for the perfect stick.

70010000074539.name: Spica Adventure
70010000074539.intro: Pack your parasol, it's time for an adventure!
70010000074539.description:
Join Nico, a little girl clad in all pink and armed with an extraordinary parasol, on a dangerous yet colorful journey through space!

From the arcade legends, TAITO, experience this formerly Japan-exclusive 2D action jump & run filled with charm and cartoonish delight on modern consoles for the very first time! Reminiscent of the parasol from Parasol Stars: Bubble Bobble III, this yellow parasol will become your favorite accessory and best weapon. Use it to take down a wild mix of enemies that come straight out of a toybox!

Whether it's slashing combos, shooting, jumping off platforms, gliding, or floating, Nico and her parasol have an arsenal of moves that are as varied as her colorful foes. Don’t forget to use the parasol for protection—and we don’t mean against the sun! Defend, parry, and reflect the enemy projectiles in up to 8 directions!

Tackle the challenge of 28 stages spread across multiple paths. With each playthrough, choose a new journey through the universe of Spica! 

Featuring:
• Straight from the Arcades: Experience an arcade classic transported to consoles for the very first time!
• A Kaleidoscope of Colors: Feast your eyes on the uniquely cute and colorful 2D graphics.
• Parasol Action: Show off your extensive combat skills with the parasol!
• Through the Universe: Choose your own journey across the 28 colorful stages of Spica.
• Legendary Arcade-inspired Soundtrack: Vibe to the rhythm of ZUNTATA’s funky tunes!

Embark on this adventure to save Spica from cute but lethal enemies... And don’t forget to pack your parasol!!

70010000074544.name: Village Tycoon: Farm City Simulator
70010000074544.intro: Looking for a fun and addictive farming simulation game? Look no further than Village Tycoon: Farm City Simulator!
70010000074544.description:
Village Tycoon: Farm City Simulator is a fun and addictive farming simulation game that challenges players to develop their farming capabilities and turn their small village into a bustling metropolis. With beautiful and fun buildings, expansions, and a variety of crops to grow, players must manage their farmfields, produce goods, and deliver orders to their citizens and neighbors to keep them happy and earn cash and XP.

The game offers a large campaign with many levels to progress through, providing players with hours of fun and engaging gameplay. The cartoon-style graphics and animations give the game a charming and whimsical feel, making it suitable for players of all ages.

Players can also decorate their farm with a variety of beautiful decorations, making their fun farm city unique and adding to the immersive gameplay experience.

The game's relaxed gameplay style allows players to take their time and enjoy the farming experience, without the pressure of strict time limits or intense competition. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or new to the farming simulation genre, Village Tycoon: Farm City Simulator offers something for everyone.

70010000074549.name: ASMR Slicing
70010000074549.intro: Slice multiple objects made of kinetic sand in the most satisfying ASMR cutting game!
70010000074549.description:
Choose your favorite cutting tool no matter if it's a playing card, flosser or just a simple kitchen knife. Just cut, cut, cut and experience those satisfying ASMR
sounds! Slice a variety of colorful objects made of kinetic sand in the shapes of food, toys, buildings, everyday objects and ordinary cubes or blocks!

Need to raise the difficulty level a bit? Turn on the challenge mode! Cut off the right weight, divide an object into a given number of parts, cut an item perfectly in half, or find things hidden inside!

Progress to unlock new mysterious objects and collect coins for completed levels to buy epic blades ranging from lightsabers and credit cards to axes and chainsaws!

Features:
- cut multiple colorful objects using unusual blades!
- listen to great ASMR sounds while cutting through items
- play in challenge mode with different tasks 
- collect money to buy epic blades
- unlock mysterious objects and slice them all
- smash cookies with life quotes using a hammer

Face the challenges and become the ultimate slice master!

70010000074551.name: Drive Hard
70010000074551.intro: A fun and addictive driving experience
70010000074551.description:
Drive Hard delivers a fun and addictive driving experience

Race through Airports, Cities and Mountain Ranges

Choose from over 40 Cars and even take them on the test track1

Compete in Races, Challenges and Time Trials

Race Hard, Win Hard, Drive Hard!

70010000074553.name: Light-It Up
70010000074553.intro: Swing, jump, flip and slide your stickman body from one neon color shape to another to make them glow and light-it up.
70010000074553.description:
In this big, dark world, you're a little stickman with a huge mission. Get ready to ignite the excitement and light your way through an epic adventure! Light up each figure, bringing it to life with vibrant colors. Get ready to test your reflexes and agility as you navigate through this colorful world of shapes and light!

Just when you start to feel like a stickman boss and love that color glow, things get complicated as you jump, flip and pass levels. Color shapes start moving, rotating, and even exploding, and lethal spikes become a constant threat to your little stickman's life. If you miss a jump, if your swing’s a dud, if your flip isn’t on point, or if you hit a spike… you fall into oblivion!

Features:
- jump, flip, slide and swing as a little stickman 
- light up 150 levels!
- think how to use obstacles to your advantage 
- avoid falling and touching the spikes 
- use 3 different boosters when you have trouble passing any of the levels
- collect stars to unlock next levels
- listen to satisfying sounds as shapes become lit up 
- unlock and wear all the skins that will make your stickman look awesome!

So what do you say, stickman? Ready to swing, jump, flip, light-it up and glow, in the brightest of all jumping games?

70010000074555.name: Tricky Taps
70010000074555.intro: Think you’re a puzzle master? Prove it! Roll the ball down the twisty roads and see how you do in this tricky puzzle game!
70010000074555.description:
Use the levers to roll and bounce the ball along the twisty roads, without letting it drop or hit the spikes! 

Keep an eye out for tons of super-cool and tricky obstacles to jump and bounce out off or avoid. Collect gems and stars which are not so easy to get as you make your way through the Tricky Taps twisted levels. Don't worry if you don't succeed the first time, try again and think of a way to get them!

Looking for more challenges? Try the endless mode! Play on random levels by going from one to another without any break until you lose your guard and lose. See how far you can go in one sitting and try to beat your record!

All the gems you earn can be spent on ball skins and their trails. Buy and select the skin of a spiked ball or cookie and add a trail of rainbows or hearts. Change the look of your ball and roll with your favorite skin!

Features:
- try to complete over 150 levels full of arcade action and get all the stars!
- use the levers to roll and bounce your ball
- avoid all kinds of obstacles placed on the levels 
- beat your records in endless mode!
- listen to catchy soundtrack 
- play your new amazing time-killer 

Ready to roll the ball? Let’s bounce!

70010000074557.name: Coin Rush
70010000074557.intro: Roll your coin along the Coin Rush twisty road track and get a perfect hit right into the hole!
70010000074557.description:
Avoid tricky obstacles like deadly spikes, secret doors, spinning gates and objects falling from the sky - getting a perfect hit into the hole can be dangerous!

Beware of the twisty road speed ramp, which makes your coin go super fast! Only those with true mastery can skillfully control their coin as it hurtles down the track!

Put on different funny skins, collect coins as you roll down and complete as many levels as possible in this never ending game!

Ready to roll?

70010000074559.name: B.O.O.L: Master labyrinth puzzles
70010000074559.description:
B.O.O.L: Master labyrinth puzzles is a fun and challenging puzzle game for everyone. B.O.O.L. stands for 'Box Out Of Labyrinth' and means to get Box out of the labyrinth and describes the aim of the game. Your task is to get the box out of the labyrinth to the target. This sounds like a simple task? You did the calculation without the puzzle masters. The game box cannot be moved freely, but only up, down, left and right and only up to the next obstacle without stopping in between. But that's not all, you only have a certain number of moves at your disposal. Get ready and face the challenge of more than 120 labyrinth puzzles.
- Puzzles in three difficulty levels.
- Puzzles contain doors, switches and the four elements earth, fire, water and air.
- Give your creativity free rein and create your own labyrinth puzzles with the editor on 100 free memory slots.

70010000074567.name: Captain Soda
70010000074567.intro: Transform into the ultimate pop bottle hero, obliterating an alien army with your sparkling soda guns!
70010000074567.description:
Captain Soda takes arcade shoot'em up platforming to new heights, boasting soda flavors with unique abilities, flashy weapons, powerful upgrades, and pulse-pounding challenges. Revel in the fluid controls that let you jiggle, slosh, and clink with satisfaction as you annihilate enemies and navigate the chaos.

Throw-down wave after wave of money-abducting alien invaders with weapons like the Bubble Sub-machine Gun and Bottle Rocket Launcher. Pick your favorite carbonated beverage and shoot water guns loaded with it, all while grooving to an Arcade Orchestral synth soundtrack composed by Aleix Ramon.

SATISFY YOUR THIRST FOR VIOLENCE

Destroy the alien invaders with a variety of short-range, long-range and melee weapons. Toss exploding cans, fly with a soda-powered jetpack, or flatten them with an entire vending machine! Hone your skills to evade and defeat 18 different types of enemies.

MIX, MATCH AND UPGRADE

Play as different soda heroes to dazzle the enemy like Lieutenant Lemonade or Major Matcha Bubble Tea. Acquire over 14 accessories and upgrades like the CO2 Boost Boots and Effervescent Wings to tailor to your play style and boost your power.

INTENSE HEART-RACING CAMPAIGN

Shoot and blast your way through a vibrant campaign across three mysterious areas with diverse carbonated themes. Complete over 60 optional missions, unlock item shops, and uncover secret upgrades as you pursue the enemy.

NEVER-ENDING ENDLESS MODE

Fight never-ending waves of enemies in rogue-like Endless mode, where each level is more intense than the last one! Can you survive the alien onslaught and achieve an eye-popping high score on the global leaderboard?

SODAFIED SPIRITUAL SUCCESSOR

Captain Soda elevates the genre with a full-fledged campaign mode, enhanced visuals, new enemies, mechanics, customizable weapon loadouts, and an expanded screen-wrapping mechanic for intense and skill-based gameplay.

FUN AND ACCESSIBLE FOR ALL

With a range of difficulty options, Captain Soda caters to beginners, experts, and speedrunners alike. Adjust settings and options like aim assist, enemy movement speed, and color blind mode to your heart's content for an optimized and enjoyable gameplay experience.

70010000074595.name: Time Master
70010000074595.intro: Time Master combines platforming and time manipulation wrapped up in a story told through cinematic cut scenes packed with surprises.
70010000074595.description:
After the disappearance of his sister Sophia (which may or may not have been his fault), talented wizard Zeno vows to never take up his wizard’s staff again. That is until a mysterious voice promises that Zeno could get his sister back... he only needs to take on a challenge created by the Ancients.

Guide Zeno as he completes the Ancients’ trials to recover time fragments and defeat the evil wizard Lucix in this relaxing puzzle game.

Experience a fully voice acted cinematic story that delivers surprises and laughs.
Take on the challenge of the Ancients and master a wide variety of puzzle mechanics.
Use Zeno’s ability to rewind time and collaborate with his past self to overcome obstacles.
Recover time fragments by either unlocking trials and completing them in the order you choose or by perfecting previously completed trials.
Oh, and help Zeno get his sister back that he “accidentally” banished.
